headline: Vessel struck by unknown projectile off Lima, Oman, at the Hormuz mouth
dek: A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile about 9 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman, near the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz. The master's report, quoted by UKMTO via AJ/Gulf News: the strike caused a hole in the starboard side; vessel and crew safe, no environmental impact reported.
sources: UKMTO Warning 193-26 (UK Maritime Trade Operations), relayed by Al Jazeera liveblog and Gulf News
fault_line: Who is still hitting ships at the mouth of Hormuz while Tehran and Washington talk about reopening it in two days -- and does a strike the day before the midterms prove the talks are a feint, or just the war grinding on
